Important Info
**We reserve the right to reject corn with vomitoxin levels over 6.0 ppm. Albion continues to monitor vomitoxin levels in our daily receipts to maintain co-product quality.
Any loads containing more than 0.5% soybeans are subject to rejection.
Notice
The Andersons reserves the right to refuse delivery of commodities containing transgenic genes and traits that are not commercially merchantable.
The Andersons fully supports the NGFA’s position that the promotion and sale of varieties that are not approved for export to key markets can cause economic harm to grain handlers and ultimately grain producers and with that, The Andersons Inc. has the right to reject delivery of commodities containing transgenic genes/traits that are not approved for sale in Japan, Mexico, the European Union, China or other US export markets.

About This Facility
The Andersons provides all the grain marketing services you have utilized over the years and also supported by a constant, local demand for corn that will add even more value to corn growers.
All the grain marketing tools which you have utilized in the past will continue to be available to market your corn, with the exception of warehouse receipted STORAGE. We regret that we are no longer able to receive soybeans or wheat, but we are able to help you market these commodities to other attractive destinations.
Dried Distillers Grain w/Solubles (DDGS) are being sold at the plant.
Please contact Lynn Fruchey, DDGS Merchant at 517-438-4991 for more information.
THE SPEED LIMIT IS 15 MPH FROM THE TIME YOU PULL INTO PLANT UNTIL THE TIME YOU LEAVE. NO SMOKING ON PROPERTY YOU WILL BE ASKED TO LEAVE IMMEDIATELY.
We are unable to lift trucks using the hoist. Thank you and we appreciate your business.
